metadata.title: PRIMECAP Management's Top Q2 2026 Move: Trimming Micron Technology Inc at a -0.71% Portfolio Impact

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Insights from the Firm's Latest 13F Filing for the Second Quarter of 2026
PRIMECAP Management (Trades, Portfolio) recently submitted its 13F filing for the second quarter of 2026, offering a window into the investment strategy of this Pasadena-based firm. Founded in 1983, PRIMECAP is an independent investment manager overseeing US-focused equity portfolios for a select group of institutions and mutual funds. The firm adheres to a disciplined philosophy built on four pillars: individual decision-making, fundamental research, a long-term horizon, and a focus on value. Using a multi-counselor model, each portfolio manager has autonomy over a distinct sleeve, seeking stocks poised to outperform over a three-to-five-year period. PRIMECAP often identifies opportunities in out-of-favor sectors, relying on conviction to weather near-term challenges when the long-term thesis remains intact.
Summary of New Buys
PRIMECAP Management (Trades, Portfolio) added a total of 10 new stocks to its portfolio during the quarter. The most significant addition was FedEx Freight Holding Co Inc (NYSE:FDXF), with 4,048,660 shares, accounting for 0.36% of the portfolio and a total value of $611.35 million. The second largest new position was Space Exploration Technologies Corp (NASDAQ:SPCX), consisting of 1,407,762 shares, representing approximately 0.14% of the portfolio, with a total value of $240.53 million. The third largest addition was Devon Energy Corp (NYSE:DVN), with 1,571,690 shares, accounting for 0.04% of the portfolio and a total value of $64.94 million.
Key Position Increases
PRIMECAP Management (Trades, Portfolio) also increased stakes in a total of 82 stocks. The most notable increase was Boston Scientific Corp (NYSE:BSX), with an additional 17,991,140 shares, bringing the total to 50,520,914 shares. This adjustment represents a significant 55.31% increase in share count, a 0.46% impact on the current portfolio, and a total value of $2.16 billion. The second largest increase was American Airlines Group Inc (NASDAQ:AAL), with an additional 21,743,000 shares, bringing the total to 70,732,954 shares. This adjustment represents a significant 44.38% increase in share count and a total value of $1.28 billion.
Summary of Sold Out Positions
PRIMECAP Management (Trades, Portfolio) completely exited 6 holdings in the second quarter of 2026. Notably, the firm sold all 2,289,750 shares of Coterra Energy Inc (CTRA), resulting in a -0.06% impact on the portfolio. Additionally, PRIMECAP liquidated all 196,260 shares of Fifth Third Bancorp (NYSE:FITB), causing a -0.01% impact on the portfolio. These exits suggest a strategic reallocation of capital toward more promising opportunities.
